description: This source file defines a utility enum 'KeychainStore' that provides static methods for loading, saving, and deleting string data in a keychain, acting as a wrapper around 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' for keychain operations.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a keychain entry for the specified service and account.
